body: [{"title":"PanKbase Differential Expression Browser","field_data_points":false,"field_data_table_format":false,"body":"\u003Cp style=\u0022font-size:16px;\u0022\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EExplore interactive visualizations of differential gene expression within human pancreatic islets. Differential expression analyses were performed on pseudobulk analyses of our \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022\/single-cell.html?PKBdatasetId=islet_of_Langerhans_scRNA_v3-3=\u0022\u003E\u003Cspan\u003Eintegrated single-cell RNA sequencing map\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cspan\u003E featuring sequences from 140 human donors sourced from \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022\/hpap-program.html\u0022 target=\u0022blank\u0022\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EHPAP\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cspan\u003E, \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022\/iidp-program.html\u0022 target=\u0022blank\u0022\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EIIDP\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cspan\u003E, and \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022\/prodo-program.html\u0022 target=\u0022blank\u0022\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EProdo\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cspan\u003E. Of the 12 cell types in the integrated map, here we show differential expression results for the 6 cell types that are most abundant and have the highest statistical power for analysis. Because genes with low counts were pre-filtered, not all genes have results represented. See detailed differential expression methods \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022https:\/\/hugeampkpncms.org\/sites\/default\/files\/images\/pankbase\/methods\/DE_methods.pdf\u0022\u003E\u003Cspan\u003Ehere\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cspan\u003E.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EFor a selected dataset and comparison, visualize an interactive heatmap of the top 20 differentially expressed genes and interactive volcano plot of all differentially expressed genes. Hover for more information about each differentially expressed gene, and click to view details in the table below. In the table below, view differential expression results for all genes, upregulated genes, or downregulated genes. Type a gene name to search. Click \u0022Show\u0022 in the Gene query column to obtain interactive violin plots and scatterplots.\u003C\/span\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EThe differential expression analysis visualized on this page takes into account technical variation using a latent variable approach. For each cell type, learn how samples are distinguished based on variables by visiting the \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022\/pca-explorer.html\u0022\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EPCA Explorer\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cspan\u003E. \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003Cspan\u003EIf you use data from this page, please review our \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Ca href=\u0022\/policies.html\u0022 target=\u0022blank\u0022\u003E\u003Cspan\u003ECitation Policies\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003Cspan\u003E to ensure proper citation of the underlying resource(s) used to generate these analyses.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\n","field_page_style":false}]
